why: The same narrow (sharp) angle turns clockwise step by step: it opens to the left, up-left, up-right, then right. Next it opens down-right, with its corner at the top-left, which is option 1. Options 2 and 4 are wide angles, not the same shape, and option 3 is almost figure 4 again.
trick: First check the shape stays the same (sharp angle), then follow the direction it opens to.
